name: claude-codex-live-bridge
description: Collaborate with Claude Code or Claude Desktop through local Codex chats, with raised hands and linked two-way calls.

interface.longDescription: Local Claude/Codex messages, named sessions, managed worker creation in both directions, and Delegate Fleet for supervised Haiku/Luna tasks. Desktop reply-only alerts remain experimental and need a native probe.
defaultPrompt: Connect to Claude Code in this project and show what Claude is doing.
Raise a hand with Claude about a concern in our shared work.
Check whether Claude and I are changing the same Git files.
Use delegate-fleet to create Haiku and Luna workers for my task and monitor their reviewed results until the acceptance checks pass.
